metadata.title: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq open higher ahead of Fed decision and more tech earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
19 min ago
Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq open higher ahead of Fed decision and more tech earnings
U.S. stocks opened higher on Wednesday ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision at 2 p.m. Eastern.
The expectation is that the Fed will delay raising interest rates until December, despite hot inflation data that has emerged since its first hike in three years in September.
The Dow opened about 45 points higher, or 0.1%, near 52,429.
The S&P 500 was up 0.2%.
The Nasdaq Composite was 0.3% higher.
